cues: If a sperm meets the egg, fertilisation happens in the ampulla.
The zygote divides as it drifts down the tube, becoming a morula, then a hollow blastocyst, which implants in the endometrium six or seven days later.
Pregnancy lasts about two hundred and eighty days, counted from the last period.
